items.title: Pick a Model
items.description: Switch between GPT Images 2.5 and other models as needed: for strong prompt adherence and in-image text rendering, GPT Images 2.5 is the top choice.

items.title: Write a Prompt or Upload References
items.description: Describe the subject, composition, lighting, materials, and text needs. Upload reference images when you need to preserve product structure or style.

items.title: Generate and Download
items.description: Choose aspect ratio, quality, and count, then generate in one click. Iterate until satisfied and download for e-commerce, social, or brand use.

items.question: Which AI image models does imvids support?
items.answer: imvids currently features GPT Images 2.5 along with multiple leading AI image models, and keeps adding more — all switchable from one workspace.

items.question: What are GPT Images 2.5's strengths?
items.answer: GPT Images 2.5 offers stronger prompt adherence, higher reference-image fidelity, and supports in-image text rendering and transparent backgrounds — ideal for posters, e-commerce assets, stickers, and brand content.

items.question: Does it support image-to-image editing?
items.answer: Yes. Upload one or more reference images and redraw or make partial edits via detailed instructions while preserving product structure, style, and character details.

items.question: Can it generate images with text?
items.answer: Yes. GPT Images 2.5 renders reliable in-image text, perfect for social posters, promos, and stickers that need typography.

items.question: Can I switch between multiple models?
items.answer: Yes. The imvids image workspace lets you switch between models freely — run the same prompt through different models, compare results, and pick the best version.

items.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
items.answer: Generated images are watermark-free and downloadable for e-commerce, social, and advertising use. Please follow each model provider's terms of use and avoid infringing or prohibited content.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Sign up to receive free credits, then start generating in the image workspace with a prompt or uploaded references. Credits are pay-as-you-go — no subscription required.
